nodes.name: profile.rs
nodes.summary: Profile (Virtuoso environment) resolution and binding across venv, user, and local scopes. Resolves profile from explicit flag / env var / venv / user config, and binds/clears it for child processes. Defines ProfileResolution, BindScope.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module with serde-free data structures, env::var probing, and Drop-side cleanup of env vars for spawned processes.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the typed RPC layer. Declares `dispatcher` and `schema` submodules; replaces raw SKILL strings with `{method, params}` calls that map to SKILL expressions and return typed JSON.
nodes.languageNotes: Trivial module-facade file (13 lines); purely submodule declarations plus documentation.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: RPC schema definitions: Method/Param/RpcSchema structs plus standard_schema() returning all built-in RPC methods (schematic, library, design, simulation, etc.) with JSON-Schema-like metadata. Drives discoverable, type-safe API for AI agents.
nodes.languageNotes: Large file (1216 lines) dominated by a single static-literal schema constructor; serde-derived Serialize/Deserialize types.

nodes.name: runtime_paths.rs
nodes.summary: Centralized filesystem path resolution for the bridge runtime. Honours VB_CACHE_DIR / VB_LOG_DIR / VB_HOME / XDG_CACHE_HOME env vars, falls back to dirs::cache_dir(), and provides a legacy_cache_file API for pre-refactor state files.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-Path module adapted from virtuoso-bridge-lite (Python). Uses std::env::var_os and PathBuf exclusively; no I/O.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: SKILL Finder client — query Cadence SKILL API docs from .fnd databases. Supports Fuzzy/Prefix/Suffix/Exact/Regex search modes, remote-host cache (~/.cache/virtuoso_bridge/skill_finder/<host>/), lazy sync, and refresh.
nodes.languageNotes: Module gated `#![allow(dead_code)]`; exports SearchMode enum, SKILLFinder struct, search/sync helpers, and re-exports parser types.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled state-machine parser for Cadence .fnd SKILL Finder database files. Yields SkillEntry triples (name, syntax, description) tolerant of comments and trailing fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Recursive-descent-style lexer without regex; comment-aware, treats SKILL string literals across newlines.

nodes.name: maestro_csv.rs
nodes.summary: Parser for Cadence Maestro "Detail" CSV exports (maeExportOutputView). Produces MaestroResult/Point/Output structs with sweep parameters and per-point measurement data, including optional raw_csv passthrough.
nodes.languageNotes: Serde-derived data model; CSV parsing helpers with HashMap-backed design variables and outputs.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for Spectre-related types. Aggregates jobs, maestro_csv, parsers, runner submodules.

nodes.name: job_progress.rs
nodes.summary: JobProgressTracker — polls a Spectre spectre.out log, parses progress lines (iteration count, time point), and emits JobEvent::Progress via a JobEventSink. Backs the streaming progress UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::fs, atomic byte-position tracking, periodic size checks; throttled reads via Instant elapsed check.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Streaming event primitives. Defines JobEvent (Started/Progress/Completed/Failed/Cancelled tagged enum), JobEventSink trait, StdoutSink/ChannelSink impls, and helpers for fan-out / throttling.
nodes.languageNotes: Tagged enum with serde rename_all="snake_case"; Arc<dyn JobEventSink> fan-out; tokio mpsc integration.

nodes.name: linux_rename.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-glibc wrapper for renameat2(..., RENAME_NOREPLACE). Tries dlsym, then raw SYS_renameat2 syscall, then a non-atomic lstat + renameat fallback for CentOS 7 / glibc 2.17.
nodes.languageNotes: cfg(target_os="linux")-gated FFI with libc::c_int / c_uint, raw pointers, and unsafe extern "C" function-pointer typedef.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for platform compatibility shims. Currently exposes linux_rename on Linux only.
nodes.languageNotes: Trivial (8 lines); only includes linux_rename under cfg(target_os = "linux").

nodes.name: test_env.rs
nodes.summary: Sentinel module documenting that env-mutating tests must use #[serial] from serial_test. Empty body, exists only to give future env-aware test helpers an obvious home.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level in-module test suite for vcli. Configures Config / SSHRunner / SessionInfo, runs SSH command-construction tests, env-var validation, and JSON round-trips. No network or Virtuoso required.
nodes.languageNotes: Large (2376 lines) file containing many #[cfg(test)] mod submodules; uses serial_test::serial for env-touching tests.

nodes.name: diff.rs
nodes.summary: SchematicDiff: structured diff between two SchematicSnapshots. Tracks instances added/removed/modified, nets added/removed, and pins added/removed with per-parameter old/new values.
nodes.languageNotes: Serde-derived structs; computes diffs by HashMap lookup on instance/pin names.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Transaction system facade: Transaction / TransactionManager lifecycle over a single VirtuosoClient. Tracks the active tx plus committed history and supports begin/commit/rollback semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: RefCell-backed interior mutability so tx_* methods take &self; HashMap of net assignments per tx.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: SchematicSnapshot: point-in-time capture of a cellview (lib/cell/view + instances, nets, pins, terminal connectivity). Round-trips through serde for diffing and persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data types plus a capture async fn that talks to VirtuosoClient; uses HashMap for instance/pin lookups.

nodes.name: vtui.rs
nodes.summary: vtui binary entrypoint. Declares all library modules and re-exports the public surface (Capability/Set, standard_schema, SchematicDiff/Snapshot, TransactionManager); calls tui::run_tui() from main.
nodes.languageNotes: 44-line mod aggregator with `#![allow(dead_code)]`; thin main() that delegates to tui::run_tui.
